creeks, roads and normally dry arroyos is likely. The heavy rains
will likely trigger rockslides, mudslides and debris flows in steep
terrain, especially in and around these areas.

260 S (Washington Twp), and CR 100 W between CR 250 W and the
White River affected by high water.

- At 8:00 AM EDT Thursday the stage was 22.2 feet.

ending at 8:00 AM EDT Thursday was 22.2 feet.

feet tomorrow evening. It will then fall below flood stage
early Wednesday morning.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 20 at 12:34PM EDT until August 22 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...

East Fork White River near Rivervale.

.Minor flooding continues along the East Fork White River in the
Rivervale area. The decrease in river levels will be very slow since
an additional secondary crest is expected at Seymour.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...East Fork White River near Rivervale.

* WHEN...Until Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 20.5 feet, Lawrenceport Road just east of
Lawrenceport and on the south side of river begins to flood around
this level. During typical floods in this area this portion of the
road can be flooded by 5 to more than 10 feet of water. During the
January 2005 flood this area would have been near the "bottom" of
the river, underwater by nearly 17 feet. In the Great March 1913
flood, more than 25 feet of water would have covered this location.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 11:30 AM EDT Thursday the stage was 20.5 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours
ending at 11:30 AM EDT Thursday was 20.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 20.6
feet this afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage
tomorrow evening.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
